facts.value: Official transcripts are certified copies of official documents from each secondary school, college, university or technical school attended. Records must include courses completed, grades or marks earned, and certificates or degrees awarded.

facts.value: You must have one set of official transcripts from every college and university from which you earned a bachelor's degree or higher sent to ASU.

metadata.chunk_title: Have official transcripts sent to Graduate Admission Services. + Step 04

facts.value: If your school(s) cannot send them directly to ASU, you may send them yourself, making sure they meet one of the following requirements: Original academic credentials issued by the registrar of the institution attended, photocopies of original academic credentials verified as true copies, or photocopies certified by a recognized international educational organization.

facts.value: Photocopies certified by a notary public are not official and scanned copies are also not accepted in lieu of original official academic documents.
